title: Root disk full from unrotated debug logs
alert: Customers see '500 Internal Server Error' on product pages; the shop homepage loads but any dynamic request fails.

truth.root_cause: A new cron job 'collect-debug-logs' was added two days ago. It writes verbose debug output to /var/log/shop/debug.log but the logrotate config was not updated for this file, so the log grows unbounded. The root disk (/) reached 97% used, leaving no space for nginx to write its access log or for the api container to write its log, causing 500 errors on all dynamic requests.
truth.fix: Move the oversized debug log from /var/log/shop/debug.log to the postgresql disk (which has 31.6 GB free), update logrotate to include this file, and disable the collect-debug-logs job until the log rotation is fixed. Then verify product pages return 200 again.

recent_changes: Added collect-debug-logs cron job (writes api debug dump to /var/log/shop/debug.log)
